**Verdict:** The claim "All 12 units demonstrate the retrofit savings" is not supported.

**Need:** To assess the claim, we must consider the population of units and the retrofit distribution.

**What matters most:**
- There are 12 units in total. - Out of these, only 7 units received the retrofit. - The remaining 5 units did not receive the retrofit.

Since only the 7 retrofitted units can demonstrate the retrofit savings, it is incorrect to claim that all 12 units demonstrate these savings.
